game_concept: A action puzzle set in Snowy Hold – Ice Mill, a frozen mill wheel: the frost mage must handle frost imps while practicing functions. Core idea – Countdown Recursion: Use a simple self-calling function to count down to a base case.
theme: Snowy Hold – Ice Mill: a frozen mill wheel
core_gameplay_loop: In Ice Mill, repeat each round: Use a simple self-calling function to count down to a base case. Each round, a new furs challenge appears; solve it to bank points before time drains. Then check the base_case value and advance.
player_objective: Collect 220 points of furs by answering each challenge with the right code concept before the clock runs out.
controls: Code-editor: type or edit short lines in the code panel and press Run; click to select targets.
lose_condition: Timer hits 0 with score < 220, or lives reach 0.
learning_alignment: Week 6 – Functions | Level 4 (applied tier): Countdown Recursion
assets_style: cozy pixel-art snow town: icy blue rooftops, frosted pines, warm lantern glow; flat Kenney-style sprites; soft bells, wind howls and cozy hearth crackle
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Countdown Recursion' (Week 6 slot 11), mission type 'Resource Rush', and setting 'Ice Mill'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: Snowy Hold
region.mood: soft bells, wind howls and cozy hearth crackle

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how base_case changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against frost imps in Ice Mill.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: score >= 220 within 39 seconds.
